scene_and_rig.camera_pose_source: Genesis official robot scene; same fixed side camera as cached R1.5

config.crop_rule: per-frame tight integer bounding box of the current candidate unknown/request mask

config.depth_occlusion: original full-scene renderer depth test remains active during the scissored draw
config.repair_rule: write exact rendered samples only at pixels marked unsupported by the current candidate request mask
config.outside_roi_rule: all requested pixels lie inside the tight bounding box; any residual outside request remains a charged full-frame direct fallback

old_checkpoint_interpretation: diagnostic only; checkpoints were trained on old generated events and do not determine candidate radiometric correctness
common_reference_policy: no ranking; compare candidate reconstruction with direct renders at the same exact logged robot states; models receive event tensors only; GT is scored after inference

candidate_total_includes: exact selected source HDR render time
moving projection, surface-raster, and static visibility preparation, counted once
per-query projection, rasterization, composition, and exact scissored HDR repair
one-time ROI/scissor installation amortized evenly across this run's episodes
direct_total_includes: all exact trace-state Direct-HDR frame render time
excluded_from_both: offline segmentation audit renders and their analysis
model inference and diagnostic artifact serialization
cost_accounting.preparation_subcomponents: static_visibility_preparation_wall_s is a diagnostic subdivision of source_preparation_wall_s and is not added a second time.
cost_accounting.numba_jit: JIT time is included in whichever timed source-preparation or reconstruction call first triggers compilation; the runtime log and per-component times preserve cold/warm differences.
